heading: top-left
name: 直式圖片網格＋圖上左上標題
desc: 上方靠左一個標題，下方一列等寬的直式圖片項目，每張圖片左上角疊一個標題。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方靠左放標題組，標題組只有標題（可多行），沒有小標籤、說明文字或按鈕；標題明顯小於下方的圖片。標題組下方是多個項目排成的網格，桌機一列排開、項目等寬等高，整組對齊頁面內容寬度。每個項目是一張直式圖片，所有圖片同一比例，標題疊在圖片的左上角；項目沒有其他文字或按鈕。
mobile: 標題組改為置中。網格改為每列兩個項目，圖片維持直式，標題仍疊在圖片左上角；網格左右兩側貼齊畫面邊緣，兩欄之間保留間距。

en.name: Portrait image grid with overlaid top-left titles
en.desc: A left-aligned heading on top, followed by a row of equal-width portrait image items, each with a title overlaid at its top-left corner.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, aligned left. The heading group contains only a title (may wrap to multiple lines), with no label, description or button. The title is clearly smaller than the images below. Below the heading group, multiple items form a grid that sits in a single row on desktop, with items of equal width and height, aligned to the page content width. Each item is a portrait image, all images share the same aspect ratio, and a title overlays the top-left corner of the image; items have no other text or buttons.
en.mobile: The heading group becomes centered. The grid changes to two items per row, images stay portrait, and the title still overlays the top-left corner of each image; the grid's left and right sides are flush with the screen edges, while a gap remains between the two columns.
